articleBody:
Getting your roof deck inspected, especially before a reroofing project or after some storm damage, is a critical step in maintaining your home's integrity. It helps ensure that the foundation for your new roof is solid and that any hidden issues are brought to light. A little preparation on your end can really help the inspectors do their best work, giving you the clearest picture of your deck's health.

**What to Prepare Before You Start**
- [ ] Locate and provide any available construction or previous repair records — why it matters: These documents offer invaluable insight into your roof's history and potential weak points, guiding the inspector to specific areas.
- [ ] Clear any access points to your attic, crawl spaces, or areas directly under the roof — why it matters: Inspectors often need to examine the underside of the deck for water staining, rot, or other damage that's not visible from above.
- [ ] Remove any stored items or obstructions from under the roof where accessible — why it matters: This ensures the inspector has a clear line of sight and safe movement to thoroughly check the deck from below.
- [ ] Point out any areas where you've noticed sagging, soft spots, or water stains on interior ceilings — why it matters: Your observations are critical clues that can direct the inspector to areas needing extra attention.
- [ ] Ensure the exterior perimeter of your home is clear of debris or obstructions — why it matters: This allows for safe and complete access to the entire roof's edge, where deck issues can sometimes manifest.
- [ ] Discuss any recurring leaks or moisture issues you've experienced — why it matters: Consistent problems can be strong indicators of underlying deck deterioration, even if the exterior damage isn't obvious.
- [ ] Have a list of questions ready for the inspector — why it matters: This ensures you get all the information you need about the assessment process, findings, and recommended next steps.

**How to use this checklist:** Before your roof deck inspection, take a few minutes to go through these points. Addressing them will not only make the inspection go smoothly but also empower you with a better understanding of your home's needs. It helps the team at Discounted Roofing Co. conduct a comprehensive and efficient assessment.

Ready to get a clear picture of your roof deck's condition? Contact Discounted Roofing Co. to schedule your detailed inspection.
